items.title: Introduction: major, minor and trace components (hawa ke bare, chhote aur bohat thore hisse) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the unnumbered introduction, printed page 305.

blocks.text: Atmosphere zameen ke gird different (alag alag) gases ka ek sphere (gola) hai. Atmosphere ke components (hisson) ko teen hisson mein baanta ja sakta hai: major (bare), minor (chhote) aur trace (bohat thore). Major components nitrogen (78.00%) aur oxygen (21.01%) hain. Minor components argon (0.93%) aur carbon dioxide (0.04%) hain. Trace components methane, hydrogen, neon, helium, krypton aur xenon hain.

blocks.caption: Atmosphere ki composition (banawat)
rows: methane, hydrogen, neon, helium, krypton, xenon

blocks.prompt: Carbon dioxide hawa ka sirf minor component hai. Phir bhi yeh climate ke liye itni important kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh atmosphere ka sirf taqreeban 0.04% hai, lekin carbon dioxide zameen se nikalne wali garmi (infrared) ko absorb (jazb) karti hai. Is liye is ki amount mein thora sa increase bhi zyada garmi rok leta hai (greenhouse effect, 14.7). Nitrogen aur oxygen, jo major gases hain, is tarah infrared absorb nahi kartin.

items: Atmosphere: N₂ 78.00% aur O₂ 21.01% (major); Ar 0.93% aur CO₂ 0.04% (minor); CH₄, H₂, Ne, He, Kr, Xe (trace).
